# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `python -m src.config > docs/CONFIGURATION.md`; edit src/config.py instead. -->

Set these in `.env` (start from `.env.example`). The Python services read them only
through `src/config.py`, which rejects invalid values by name when a service starts or
a request needs them. An empty value means the default. Secrets are marked 🔒.

## Database

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` 🔒 |  | SQLAlchemy URL of the Postgres database. Required. | api, worker, beat |
| `ASYNC_DATABASE_URL` 🔒 |  | Async SQLAlchemy URL. Derived from `DATABASE_URL` when empty. | api |
| `DB_POOL_SIZE` | `20` | Connections kept in each process's pool. | api, worker, beat |
| `DB_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `10` | Extra connections allowed above the pool size. | api, worker, beat |

## Queue

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CELERY_BROKER_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Celery broker. | api, worker, beat |
| `CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND` | `redis://localhost:6379/1` | Celery result backend. | api, worker, beat |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis for the shared scan cache (`SCANNER_CACHE_BACKEND=redis`). | worker |

## API and access

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PYTHON_API_KEY` 🔒 |  | Key the dashboard sends to the API. Required. | api |
| `DASHBOARD_DEFAULT_ROLES` | `dashboard,operator` | Roles of API-key sessions. `remediator` and `security-operator` are needed to propose, approve, execute and publish remediations. | api |
| `DASHBOARD_TRUSTED_PROXY_SECRET` 🔒 |  | Shared secret of a trusted ingress that forwards verified user identity headers. | api |
| `SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET` 🔒 |  | HMAC secret for signed service-to-service requests. | api |
| `SERVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED` | `false` | Require signed service requests instead of accepting the API key. | api |
| `SERVICE_AUTH_MAX_SKEW_SECONDS` | `300` | Allowed clock skew for signed service requests. | api |
| `NODE_ENV` |  | `production` refuses SQLite database URLs. | api, worker, beat |
| `SCRUTINEERING_VERSION` | `1.0` | Version reported by `/version`. | api |
| `SCRUTINEERING_REVISION` | `unknown` | Revision reported by `/version`. | api |

## Local registry

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LOCAL_REGISTRY_HOST` | `registry:5000` | The bundled registry as the services reach it. | api, worker, beat |
| `LOCAL_REGISTRY_URL` |  | Its URL for the services. Derived from the host when empty. | api |
| `LOCAL_REGISTRY_PUBLIC_HOST` | `localhost:5000` | The bundled registry as you push to it from the host. | api |
| `LOCAL_REGISTRY_PUBLIC_URL` |  | Its URL from the host. Derived from the public host when empty. | api |
| `REGISTRY_INSECURE` | `false` | Allow plain HTTP to the local registry (and `localhost`) only. Every other registry uses TLS. | api, worker, beat |

## Scanning

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCANNER_TIMEOUT` | `600` | Seconds one scanner may run against one image. | worker |
| `SCANNER_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES` | `50000000` | Largest scanner report accepted. | worker |
| `SCANNER_MAX_FINDINGS` | `100000` | Most findings accepted from one report. | worker |
| `SCANNER_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` | `2` | Retries for transient scanner failures. | worker |
| `SCANNER_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS` | `5.0` | First retry delay; it doubles each retry. | worker |
| `SCANNER_CACHE_DIR` | `/tmp/trivy-cache` | Trivy's cache directory. | worker |
| `SCANNER_CACHE_BACKEND` | `local` | Where scan results are cached: per worker, or shared in Redis. | worker |
| `SCANNER_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` | `3600` | How long cached results are reused. | worker |
| `REQUIRE_IMMUTABLE_SCAN_IDENTITY` | `false` | Fail a scan whose tag cannot be resolved to a digest, instead of scanning by tag. | worker |
| `SCAN_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` | `3600` | Scheduled scans skip images scanned this recently. | worker |
| `SCHEDULE_CRON_SCAN` | `0 */6 * * *` | Cron expression (five fields) for scheduled rescans of known images. | beat |

## Runtime discovery

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_DISCOVERY_ENABLED` | `false` | Scan the images of running containers on a schedule. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_USE_CONTAINERD` | `false` | List containers with `ctr` instead of `docker`. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_DOCKER_BIN` | `docker` | Docker CLI to list containers with. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_CTR_BIN` | `ctr` | containerd CLI to list containers with. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_CONTAINERD_NAMESPACE` | `default` | containerd namespace to list. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_INCLUDE_IMAGES` |  | Only images matching these glob patterns. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_EXCLUDE_IMAGES` |  | Skip images matching these glob patterns. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_EXCLUDE_CONTAINERS` |  | Skip containers whose names match these glob patterns. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_INCLUDE_LABEL` |  | Only containers with this `key=value` label. | worker |
| `SCAN_RUNTIME_MAX_IMAGES` | `100` | Most images scanned per discovery run. | worker |

## Registry credentials

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DOCKERHUB_USERNAME` |  | Docker Hub user, with `DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD`. | api, worker, beat |
| `DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD` 🔒 |  | Docker Hub password or token. | api, worker, beat |
| `GITHUB_USERNAME` | `gh_token` | User name sent with `GITHUB_TOKEN` to ghcr.io. | api, worker, beat |
| `GITLAB_USERNAME` | `gitlab-ci-token` | User name sent with the GitLab token to registry.gitlab.com. | api, worker, beat |
| `GITLAB_TOKEN` 🔒 |  | Token for registry.gitlab.com. | api, worker, beat |
| `CI_JOB_TOKEN` 🔒 |  | GitLab CI job token, used when `GITLAB_TOKEN` is empty. | api, worker, beat |
| `REGISTRY_CREDENTIALS_JSON` 🔒 |  | Credentials for any other registry: `{"harbor.example": {"username": "bot", "password": "..."}}`. | api, worker, beat |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` |  | AWS key for ECR, read by the scanners. Must be set with the secret. | worker |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` 🔒 |  | AWS secret for ECR, read by the scanners. | worker |

## Remediation and GitHub

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REMEDIATION_EXECUTION_ENABLED` | `false` | Allow approved remediations to patch the source, build a candidate and scan it. | api |
| `REMEDIATION_SOURCES_ROOT` | `/workspace/sources` | Where the worker finds local source repositories. | worker |
| `BUILDKIT_HOST` | `tcp://buildkitd:1234` | The rootless BuildKit service candidates are built on. | worker |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` 🔒 |  | Opens pull requests and clones github.com sources (Contents and Pull requests read/write on the source repositories), and pulls from ghcr.io. | api, worker, beat |
| `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` 🔒 |  | Verifies the `pull_request` webhook that reports merges. | api |

## Tests

| Variable | Default | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCRUTINEERING_TEST_MODE` | `false` | Tests only: allow an in-memory database when `DATABASE_URL` is unset. | api, worker, beat |

## Read by Compose, the dashboard or the scanners

| Variable | Meaning | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_USER` | Postgres user created by the Compose `postgres` service. | Compose |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | Its password. Required. | Compose |
| `POSTGRES_DB` | Database created by the `postgres` service. | Compose |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | Host port for Postgres with `docker-compose.host-access.yml`. | Compose |
| `REDIS_PORT` | Host port for Redis with `docker-compose.host-access.yml`. | Compose |
| `LOCAL_REGISTRY_PORT` | Host port of the bundled registry. | Compose |
| `PYTHON_API_PORT` | Host port of the API. | Compose |
| `DASHBOARD_PORT` | Host port of the dashboard. | Compose |
| `REMEDIATION_HOST_SOURCES` | Host folder mounted read-only as the worker's sources root. | Compose |
| `CELERY_QUEUES` | Queues the worker consumes. Include `remediation.normal` to run remediations. | Compose |
| `CELERY_CONCURRENCY` | Worker processes. | Compose |
| `CELERY_LOG_LEVEL` | Worker and beat log level. | Compose |
| `DASHBOARD_API_URL` | API URL the dashboard server calls. Defaults to the Compose service. | dashboard |
| `DASHBOARD_API_KEY` | Key the dashboard server sends. Defaults to `PYTHON_API_KEY`. | dashboard |
| `DASHBOARD_AUTH_MODE` | `local` (API-key sessions) or `trusted-proxy` (identity from the ingress). | dashboard |
| `HOSTNAME` | Address the dashboard server listens on (Kubernetes sets `0.0.0.0`). | dashboard |
| `PORT` | Port the dashboard server listens on. | dashboard |
| `HOME` | The worker's home for git and npm; Kubernetes sets `/tmp` (read-only root). | worker |
| `PGDATA` | Postgres data directory; Kubernetes uses a subdirectory of the volume. | Postgres image |
| `REGISTRY_STORAGE_DELETE_ENABLED` | Lets the in-cluster registry delete images. | registry image |
| `GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR` | Grype's vulnerability database directory. | Grype |
| `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` | Service account file for GCR and Artifact Registry. | Trivy, Grype |
